description.narrative: The National Museum of Peru project was initiated through an agreement between UNOPS and the Peruvian Ministry of Culture (MINCUL), the project scope involved the design, construction, and commissioning of a 66,106.80 square meter museum. The project is now in its closing phase.\n\nThe objective of the closing phase is to ensure a seamless and successful transition through the completion of all remaining construction activities, the negotiation and agreement of operational and financial closure terms with MINCUL, and the final handover of the museum.
